definition: Anomalous means departing from what is standard, normal, or expected.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word anomalous. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know anomalous should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: The night-shift technician flagged an anomalous reading from the water sensor, a spike of pressure that matched nothing in the plant's normal cycle.
An unusual result is merely uncommon, while an anomalous one clashes with the established pattern and demands an explanation.
An anomalous reading breaks the expected pattern, but a freakish one is so wildly out of range that it seems almost unbelievable.

Irregular describes the uneven shape or timing of a whole series or schedule, as in an irregular heartbeat or irregular attendance. Anomalous points at a single result or reading that clashes with what the established pattern predicts, and so demands an explanation.

Abnormal measures something against a general or healthy standard, and it usually passes judgment: abnormal levels are worrying. Anomalous is the cooler, more technical word — it says only that a result fails to fit the established pattern, without judging it good or bad.

Inconsistent means failing to agree with the rest of the data or behavior; the pieces do not line up with one another. An anomalous result goes further: it clashes with the whole established pattern so sharply that it cannot simply be explained away.

The dendrochronology lab had sampled the old fir for a routine climate study.
Ring after ring told the same story: wide growth in wet decades, narrow growth in dry ones, all in step with the region's rainfall records.
Then the graduate students hit the ring for 1816, which was anomalous -- far narrower than either neighbor, in a year the rain gauges called ordinary.
It fit nothing the pattern predicted, and the team refused to average it away without a reason.
Weeks later they traced it to a distant volcanic eruption that had dimmed summers half a world away.
